simple.prompt: Nominalizing the verb 'assess': 'The committee carried out a thorough ___ of the environmental impact.'
simple.explanation: Kata kerja 'assess' dinominalisasi menjadi kata benda 'assessment' ('carry out an assessment').

simple.prompt: Nominalizing 'decide': 'Their prompt ___ prevented further escalation of the crisis.'
Susun kalimat nominalisasi dari 'The team investigated'.
simple.targetSentence: An investigation was conducted by the forensic team.
simple.explanation: An investigation (noun) + was conducted + by the forensic team.
hints: Mulai dengan nomina: 'An investigation was conducted'.

simple.prompt: Nominalizing 'destroy': 'The hurricane caused catastrophic ___ across the coastal towns.'
Susun kalimat nominalisasi dengan 'The discovery of'.
simple.targetSentence: The discovery of penicillin revolutionized modern medicine.
simple.explanation: The discovery of penicillin + revolutionized modern medicine.
hints: Mulai dengan frasa nomina: 'The discovery of penicillin'.

simple.prompt: Nominalizing 'expand': 'The company announced a major global ___ plan.'
Susun kalimat nominalisasi dengan 'The implementation of'.
simple.targetSentence: The implementation of the new policy took several months.
simple.explanation: The implementation of the new policy + took several months.
hints: Mulai dengan subjek nomina: 'The implementation of the new policy'.

simple.prompt: What is the standard noun form (nominalization) of the verb 'decide'?
simple.explanation: Nominalisasi mengubah kata kerja atau kata sifat menjadi kata benda abstrak: 'decide' (verb) → 'decision' (noun).
hints: Cari kata yang dapat didahului 'a' atau 'the' ('make a ___').

simple.prompt: Identify the noun form derived from the adjective 'accurate':
simple.explanation: Adjective berakhiran '-ate' sering berubah menjadi kata benda berakhiran '-acy': 'accurate' → 'accuracy'.

simple.prompt: Verb: 'They analyzed the water samples quickly.' → Nominalized start: 'Their rapid ___ of the water samples helped the clinic.'
simple.explanation: Verb 'analyze' berubah menjadi noun 'analysis', dan adverb 'quickly' berubah menjadi adjective 'rapid' di depan noun tersebut.
hints: Setelah adjective 'rapid', kita wajib memakai kata benda (noun).

simple.prompt: Which sentence turns an action verb into a formal noun phrase?
options: The timely implementation of safety upgrades lowered risks.
Engineers implemented safety upgrades timely to lower risks.
Safety upgrades were fastly implemented by engineers.
simple.explanation: Mengubah 'implemented' menjadi frasa kata benda 'The timely implementation of safety upgrades' adalah inti teknik nominalisasi.
hints: Cari kalimat yang mengubah kata kerja menjadi noun berakhiran '-tion'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan penyuntingan ringkasan laporan agar terdengar lebih akademis.
dialogue: Advisor
How can I make 'Prices rose suddenly, which worried commuters' more compact?
Tutor
Turn 'Prices rose suddenly' into the noun phrase: '___ worried commuters.'
simple.explanation: Adverb 'suddenly' menjadi adjective 'sudden' dan verb 'rose' menjadi noun 'rise': 'A sudden rise in prices'.

simple.prompt: Adjective: 'The battery is remarkably durable.' → Nominalized phrase: 'The remarkable ___ of the battery impressed testers.'
simple.explanation: Adjective berakhiran '-ble' berubah menjadi kata benda abstrak berakhiran '-bility': 'durable' → 'durability'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan menggabungkan adverb '-ly' dengan kata benda hasil nominalisasi berikut.
simple.draft: The rapid and thoroughly investigation of the outage restored client trust.
options: The rapid and thorough investigation of the outage restored client trust.
The rapidly and thoroughly investigate of the outage restored client trust.
The rapid and thorough investigate of the outage restored client trust.
simple.explanation: Begitu verb ('investigate') diubah menjadi kata benda ('investigation'), ia harus diterangkan oleh ADJECTIVE ('thorough'), bukan adverb ('thoroughly').
hints: 'Investigation' adalah noun sehingga tidak boleh diterangkan adverb '-ly'.

simple.prompt: Nominalize the verb 'fail': 'The cooling valve failed.' → 'The ___ of the cooling valve halted production.'
simple.explanation: Kata benda baku hasil nominalisasi 'fail' dalam laporan teknik dan bisnis adalah 'failure'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat menggunakan subjek hasil nominalisasi dari verb 'expand'.
simple.targetSentence: The rapid expansion of coastal ports boosted regional exports.
simple.explanation: Subjek frasa benda 'The rapid expansion of coastal ports' memadatkan klausa 'Ports expanded rapidly'.
hints: Awali dengan 'The rapid expansion of coastal ports'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat nominalisasi yang mengubah adjective 'available' menjadi noun.
simple.targetSentence: Limited availability of spare parts delayed the ferry repair.
simple.explanation: 'Available' menjadi kata benda 'availability' yang berpasangan dengan adjective 'Limited'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Limited availability of spare parts'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog pergeseran register verbal ke nominal.
dialogue: Informal Speaker
When temperatures rose, the Arctic ice melted more rapidly.
Academic Author
The ___ in temperature led to accelerated ice melt.
intermediate.explanation: Verba 'temperatures rose' dipadatkan secara akademis menjadi 'The rise in temperature...'.
hints: Bentuk kata benda dari verba rise.

intermediate.prompt: Transforming adjectives into abstract nouns: 'He was resilient' -> 'His ___ under pressure was commendable.'
hints: Bentuk kata benda abstrak dari resilient.

intermediate.prompt: Academic compression: 'Because the government failed to intervene...' becomes 'The government's ___ led to widespread panic.'
intermediate.explanation: Klausa 'failed to intervene' dipadatkan menjadi noun phrase elegan: 'The government's failure to intervene'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pemadatan akademik dari 'they were absent'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Frequent employee absence significantly lowered quarterly productivity.
intermediate.explanation: Frequent employee absence (noun phrase) + significantly lowered quarterly productivity.

intermediate.prompt: Turning complex actions into grammatical subjects: 'We need to eradicate poverty' -> 'The ___ of poverty is our foremost mandate.'
Susun kalimat akademik dengan subjek nominal 'The rapid proliferation'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The rapid proliferation of digital smartphones transformed human communication.
intermediate.explanation: The rapid proliferation of digital smartphones + transformed human communication.
hints: Mulai dengan nomina: 'The rapid proliferation of digital smartphones'.

dialogue: Researcher
We observed how birds migrate in autumn.
Editor
Let's entitle the paper: '___ of Autumn Avian Migration Patterns'.
intermediate.explanation: Judul akademik baku mengutamakan bentuk nominal murni: 'Observations of...'.
hints: Bentuk kata benda jamak formal untuk judul riset.

intermediate.prompt: Look at how nominalization packs two clauses into one: 'Because rural clinics were underfunded, staff turnover increased.' → '___ led to higher staff turnover.'
intermediate.explanation: Seluruh klausa sebab ('Because rural clinics were underfunded') dipadatkan menjadi subjek noun phrase tunggal: 'Chronic underfunding of rural clinics', diikuti verb kausal 'led to'.
hints: Seluruh sebab harus menjadi satu frasa benda subjek sebelum verb 'led to'.

intermediate.prompt: Identify the best noun transformation for 'The public responded skeptically to the tax proposal':
options: Widespread public skepticism toward the tax proposal
Publicly skeptical responding to the tax proposal
Skeptic response of public to tax proposal
intermediate.explanation: 'Skeptically' → 'skepticism' (atau 'skeptical response'); frasa 'Widespread public skepticism toward the tax proposal' sangat alami dan presisi secara akademis.
hints: Cek susunan modifier + noun + preposition yang tepat.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan penyuntingan naskah tentang menghindari 'empty verbs' berlebihan saat nominalisasi.
dialogue: Editor
Compare 'The panel conducted an evaluation of the bridge' with 'The panel evaluated the bridge.' Why prefer the second in action writing?
Writer
Nominalizing every verb with weak fillers like 'conduct/make' creates ___ when no thematic packaging is needed.
options: higher grammatical accuracy in every context
intermediate.explanation: Nominalisasi yang berlebihan ('zombie nouns' + empty verb 'conduct an evaluation' / 'make an announcement') justru membuat tulisan bertele-tele jika tidak dipakai untuk menyambung argumen antar-kalimat.
hints: Nominalisasi hanya efektif jika meningkatkan kepadatan ide atau kohesi.
Terlalu banyak 'conduct an X of' membuat kalimat lamban dan bertele-tele.

intermediate.prompt: Once a verb becomes a noun phrase, notice its syntactic role: 'Strict adherence to sanitation rules prevents contamination.' Here, 'Strict adherence to sanitation rules' serves as...
options: the grammatical Subject of the sentence
intermediate.explanation: Nominalisasi memungkinkan seluruh gagasan proses ('adhering strictly to sanitation rules') berfungsi utuh sebagai SUBJEK gramatikal sebelum verb 'prevents'.
hints: Lihat posisinya tepat sebelum main verb tunggal 'prevents'.
Frasa nominalisasi itu menduduki posisi Subject.

intermediate.prompt: Choose the precise nominalized counterpart of 'reliable' for an engineering abstract:
intermediate.explanation: Kata benda untuk sifat dapat diandalkannya sistem/mesin ('reliable') adalah 'reliability' (sedangkan 'reliance' berasal dari 'rely on' = ketergantungan pada).

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan Subject-Verb Agreement setelah frasa nominalisasi ber-preposisi panjang berikut.
intermediate.draft: The systematic collection of telemetry from thousands of coastal sensors provide reliable storm alerts.
options: The systematic collection of telemetry from thousands of coastal sensors provides reliable storm alerts.
The systematic collection of telemetry from thousands of coastal sensors are providing reliable storm alerts.
The systematic collect of telemetry from thousands of coastal sensors provides reliable storm alerts.
intermediate.explanation: Inti subjek kalimat ini adalah kata benda tunggal hasil nominalisasi 'The systematic collection' (bukan 'sensors'), sehingga kata kerjanya wajib tunggal ('provides').
hints: Temukan inti kata benda subjek sebelum preposisi 'of'.

intermediate.prompt: In Cause-Effect academic writing, nominalization replaces 'because' with relational verbs such as ___.
intermediate.explanation: Keunggulan besar nominalisasi adalah menghubungkan Sebab (noun phrase 1) dan Akibat (noun phrase 2) memakai kata kerja kausal tepat seperti 'resulted in', 'triggered', atau 'contributed to'.
hints: Dibutuhkan verb penghubung hubungan sebab-akibat antarnomina.

intermediate.prompt: Transform 'The clinic maintains equipment poorly, which causes breakdowns' into a dense nominalized opening: '___ frequently triggers equipment breakdowns.'
intermediate.explanation: Verb 'maintains' berubah menjadi 'maintenance', dan adverb 'poorly' berubah menjadi adjective 'Poor': 'Poor equipment maintenance'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat akademis ber-nominalisasi yang menghubungkan dua nomina dengan 'contributed to'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Gradual soil erosion contributed to lower agricultural yields across the valley.
intermediate.explanation: Nomina penyebab ('Gradual soil erosion') + relational verb ('contributed to') + nomina akibat ('lower agricultural yields').
hints: Awali dengan 'Gradual soil erosion contributed to'.
Tambahkan frasa akibat 'lower agricultural yields across the valley'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat ringkas dengan merevisi nominalisasi yang terlalu bertele-tele menjadi verb langsung.
intermediate.targetSentence: Engineers inspected every bridge joint thoroughly instead of conducting a lengthy review.
intermediate.explanation: Mengganti 'conducting an inspection of' dengan 'inspected' membuat kalimat tegas dan lugas.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Engineers inspected every bridge joint thoroughly'.
Kontraskan dengan 'instead of conducting a lengthy review'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kalimat yang menderita 'heavy nominalization' (zombie nouns yang membuat tulisan kaku dan sulit dipahami).
complex.draft: The commencement of the operationalization of the strategy will be made by management.
options: Management will begin operationalizing the strategy.
The operationalization of strategy will have commencement.
There will be a commencement by management to operationalize.
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi berlebihan (zombie nouns seperti 'commencement of the operationalization') merusak kejelasan. Penulisan yang baik mengembalikan kata kerja aktif: 'Management will begin operationalizing the strategy'.
hints: Kembalikan kata kerja aktif yang lincah dan jelas.
Pilih 'Management will begin operationalizing the strategy'.

complex.prompt: Syntactic role of nominalization in academic writing:
options: It packages entire complex processes into thematic 'things' (noun concepts) that can be commented on, evaluated, or linked as grammatical subjects.
It is a decorative technique with no linguistic function.
It is only used when the author does not know the subject.
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi mengemas proses dinamis (verba) menjadi entitas statis (nomina) yang kemudian dapat dijadikan subjek gramatikal untuk dianalisis lebih lanjut (information packaging).
hints: Fungsi pengemasan proses menjadi konsep tematik (thematic packaging).
Pilih opsi packages entire complex processes into thematic things.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence illustrating sophisticated lexical nominalization of causal relationships:
options: Urbanization triggered the depletion of local groundwater reserves.
People moved to cities and so they used up all the water underground.
Because people lived in urban places, water went away.
complex.explanation: Kausalitas informal ('people moved to cities and so...') diubah menjadi struktur nominal padat: 'Urbanization (subjek) triggered the depletion of local groundwater reserves (objek nominal)'.
hints: Gaya tulisan ilmiah dengan kepadatan leksikal tinggi.
Pilih opsi dengan 'Urbanization triggered the depletion'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat ilmiah padat dengan nominalisasi sebab-akibat.
complex.targetSentence: Deforestation contributed to the destabilization of local microclimates.
complex.explanation: Deforestation (noun) + contributed to + the destabilization of local microclimates (noun phrase).
hints: Predikat dan objek: 'contributed to the destabilization of local microclimates'.

complex.draft: The analyze of the quantitative data demonstrated high statistical reliability.
options: The analysis of the quantitative data demonstrated high statistical reliability.
The analyzing of the quantitative data demonstrated reliability.
The analytical of the quantitative data demonstrated reliability.
complex.explanation: Bentuk kata benda yang tepat dari kata kerja 'analyze' adalah 'analysis' (bukan analyze/analyzement).

complex.prompt: When does an expert editor recommend unpacking nominalizations back into active verbs?
options: When abstract nouns pile up and obscure who did what to whom, resulting in sluggish prose.
Whenever a sentence has more than five words.
Never; all academic sentences must consist solely of nouns.
complex.explanation: Jika tumpukan kata benda abstrak mengaburkan pelaku dan alur aksi, editor merekomendasikan untuk membongkar nomina tersebut kembali ke kata kerja aktif yang lugas.
hints: Ketika teks menjadi kaku dan mengaburkan pelaku serta tindakan.
Pilih opsi obscure who did what to whom.

dialogue: Professor
Why is 'The intensification of hostilities precipitated diplomatic collapse' preferred in scholarly articles?
Doctoral Candidate
Because it encapsulates two complex historical events into ___.
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi memadatkan dua peristiwa bersejarah yang kompleks menjadi satu rantai kausal SVO yang padat dan presisi.
hints: Memadatkan peristiwa ke dalam rantai kausal SVO ringkas.

complex.prompt: Examine cohesive flow (Given-New progression) across two sentences: 'Coastal planners recently expanded mangrove buffers along the bay. This strategic ___ sharply reduced tidal flooding.'
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi ('This strategic expansion') sangat vital dalam tulisan IELTS/akademik untuk merangkum aksi kalimat sebelumnya ('expanded...') menjadi topik ringkas (Given information) di awal kalimat berikutnya!
hints: Rujuk kembali kata kerja 'expanded' di kalimat pertama menjadi noun.

complex.prompt: Identify the over-nominalized ('zombie noun') sentence that should be edited back into crisp active prose:
options: The committee reached an agreement on the implementation of a reduction in overtime hours.
The committee agreed to reduce overtime hours.
Reducing overtime hours allowed the team to recover faster.
complex.explanation: Menumpuk empat nominalisasi abstrak sekaligus ('reached an agreement', 'implementation', 'reduction') dengan weak verb 'reached' menciptakan kabut birokratis; menyederhanakannya menjadi verb langsung ('agreed to reduce') jauh lebih kuat.
hints: Cari kalimat yang penuh kata benda abstrak '-tion/-ment' bersambung dengan 'of' bertumpuk.
Bandingkan kejelasan kalimat pertama dengan dua lainnya.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan preposisi yang salah setelah nominalisasi kata kerja transitif berikut.
complex.draft: Our engineering unit appreciated the client's prompt accept of the revised schedule.
options: Our engineering unit appreciated the client's prompt acceptance of the revised schedule.
Our engineering unit appreciated the client's prompt accepting for the revised schedule.
Our engineering unit appreciated the client's prompt acceptation on the revised schedule.
complex.explanation: Bentuk nominalisasi baku dari 'accept' adalah 'acceptance' (bukan verb 'accept' maupun kata usang 'acceptation'), diikuti preposisi 'of' sebelum objek aslinya.
hints: Objek langsung dari 'accept' berubah menjadi 'of + objek'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang hubungan kata benda abstrak dengan penghilangan subjek manusia.
dialogue: Reviewer
Notice how 'Analysts proved that wages stagnated' became 'The demonstration of wage stagnation...'. What was gained?
Author
Packaging the clause into a noun phrase lets us treat the finding as ___ and push it into a new cause-effect claim.
options: an established concept that can serve as subject or object
an informal anecdote for spoken conversation
a subjective personal opinion lacking evidence
complex.explanation: Mengubah proses/klausa menjadi nomina ('wage stagnation') memungkinkan gagasan kompleks diperlakukan sebagai entitas baku yang siap dianalisis atau dihubungkan dengan faktor lain.
hints: Nominalisasi memadatkan klausa menjadi konsep yang dapat berfungsi sebagai subjek/objek kalimat baru.

complex.prompt: Choose the sentence that transforms an adjective + clause cleanly WITHOUT losing grammatical precision: 'Although the new alloy is expensive, it resists salt corrosion well.' →
options: Despite its high cost, the new alloy exhibits strong resistance to salt corrosion.
Despite expensive of it, the new alloy exhibits strongly resistant to salt corrosion.
Although its high cost, the new alloy exhibits strong resistance to salt corrosion.
complex.explanation: 'Although it is expensive' → 'Despite its high cost'; 'resists well' → 'exhibits strong resistance to...'. Seluruh preposisi ('Despite', 'to') dan kelas kata sesuai kaidah formal.
hints: Periksa pasangan 'Despite + noun phrase' dan 'resistance + to'.
Pastikan tidak ada campuran 'Although + noun phrase'.

complex.prompt: Note how verb-preposition combinations shift under nominalization: 'to rely on solar power' becomes 'heavy ___ solar power'.
complex.explanation: Saat kata kerja 'rely on' dinominalisasi menjadi 'reliance', ia mempertahankan preposisi bawaannya ('reliance on'), bukan otomatis diganti menjadi 'of'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan tata bahasa dan penggunaan modifier pada kalimat nominalisasi berikut.
complex.draft: A dramatically increase in offshore wind capacity depend on grid modernization.
options: A dramatic increase in offshore wind capacity depends on grid modernization.
A dramatically increase in offshore wind capacity depends on grid modernization.
A dramatic increase in offshore wind capacity are depending on grid modernization.
complex.explanation: Dua perbaikan penting: 1) Sebelum noun 'increase', gunakan adjective 'dramatic' (bukan adverb 'dramatically'); 2) Inti subjeknya tunggal ('A dramatic increase'), sehingga verb wajib tunggal 'depends'.
hints: Kata benda 'increase' diterangkan oleh adjective, bukan adverb '-ly'.

complex.prompt: Which noun form correctly preserves the meaning of 'disclose' (mengungkapkan fakta) in corporate governance?
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi baku untuk 'disclose' adalah 'disclosure' ('financial disclosure'), bukan 'disclosement'.
hints: Akhiran kata benda untuk 'disclose' dan 'enclose' adalah '-ure'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat kohesif yang merujuk ulang kalimat sebelumnya memakai 'This rapid + [nominalization]'.
complex.targetSentence: This rapid urbanization placed unprecedented strain on suburban water mains.
complex.explanation: Frasa nominalisasi 'This rapid urbanization' meringkas fenomena pertumbuhan kota sebagai subjek tunggal.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat nominalisasi yang mengubah dua kata sifat menjadi subjek abstrak terukur.
complex.targetSentence: Greater transparency and accountability strengthened investor confidence across regional markets.
complex.explanation: 'Transparent' dan 'accountable' menjadi dua kata benda abstrak sejajar sebagai subjek majemuk untuk 'strengthened'.
